card.name: USP and quality-standard phrases
card.fires_on: The letters of USP (U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention) such as the P in US-P and the F in USP-NF, plus small linking words in pharmacy compliance or inspection phrases like 'particles and discoloration'.

modes.label: USP abbreviation
modes.description: Inside or right after the name or initials of the US Pharmacopeia.

modes.label: Linking words in inspection or conformity phrases
modes.description: Small words like and, of, the, for in statements about checking particles, conformity, or compatibility.
